entities.name: Raddic of Kroog
entities.description: Yotian soldier and leader of the Church of Tal who led the First Talite Crusade.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Fanatical church that crusaded against machines.

entities.name: Second Talite Crusade
entities.description: Crusade in which Raddic died at Mishra's Fortress.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Leader of Penregon who confronted Raddic.

events.summary: Raddic's crusade confronts Penregon and he issues an ultimatum to cast out the machines.
events.quote: Raddic issued an ultimatum: cast out the machines or face destruction.

events.summary: Penregon's defenders repel the Talite assault on the walls.
events.quote: Penregon's defenders successfully repelled the Talite crusaders' assault on the city walls.

events.summary: Infiltrated Talites attack the city but are quelled.
events.quote: quelling the insurgents through fierce street-to-street fighting

events.summary: The Talites raid Urza's Tower and march on Mishra's Fortress.
events.quote: they successfully raided Urza's Tower , leaving it stripped and abandoned

events.summary: Raddic is killed fighting at Mishra's Fortress.
events.quote: many of the faithful, including Raddic, were killed in the brutal conflict.

relations.quote: he was the leader of the fledgling Church of Tal
Raddic's demands challenged the city's leadership
